texts.value: Catalyzes the transfer of phosphatidylinositol and phosphatidylcholine between membranes (PubMed:10531358, PubMed:18636990, PubMed:20332109). Also catalyzes the transfer of sphingomyelin (By similarity). Required for COPI-mediated retrograde transport from the Golgi to the endoplasmic reticulum; phosphatidylinositol and phosphatidylcholine transfer activity is essential for this function (PubMed:20332109)
Phosphatidylinositol transfer activity is inhibited by N-ethylmaleimide
Primarily cytosolic in its closed conformation, it becomes enriched on Golgi and endoplasmic reticulum membranes in its open state, where it mediates lipid transfer
Widely expressed in various tissues including brain
Constitutive phosphorylation of Ser-262 has no effect on phospholipid transfer activity but is required for Golgi targeting
Belongs to the PtdIns transfer protein family. PI transfer class I subfamily

features.description: Loss of phosphatidylinositol transfer activity but no effect on phosphatidylcholine transfer activity. Fails to rescue the retrograde transport defect from the Golgi to endoplasmic reticulum in PITPNB-deficient cells.
